nodes.name: Morning Check (6am)
nodes.notes: Runs at 6:00 AM daily. Checks for upcoming reminders, schedule conflicts, and pending follow-ups. Runs BEFORE the 7am daily digest so alerts go out first.

nodes.name: Sunday Evening Preview (8pm)
nodes.notes: Runs Sunday at 8:00 PM. Sends a preview of the upcoming week.

nodes.name: Evening Follow-up Check (6pm)
nodes.notes: Runs at 6:00 PM daily. Checks for action items that haven't been addressed and sends follow-up nudges.

nodes.name: Real-Time Alert Webhook
nodes.notes: Called by other workflows when an urgent or time-sensitive item is detected. Body: { type: 'conflict|urgent|deadline|weather', details: object, source: string }
